Dear Mr. Epstein,
On behalfof the Pritzker Family, we kindly request the pleasure of your company at a ceremony to honor
         the 2017 Laureates of the Pritzker Architecture Prize, Rafael Arend*, Carme Pigem and
         Ramon Villa, in the presence of members the Imperial Family of Japan, on Saturday, May
         20th in Tokyo. The ceremony will begin at 5:30pm at the State Guest House, Akasaka Palace: and the
         dinner reception will take place at 7:00pm at the Grand Hyatt Tokyo.

Please find attached, conesponding information and details. For inquiries or to RSVP, please feel free to respond
           to me directly.


Best,
Eunice
